checklist.noContactWithPaint: Nothing touches the paint surface: corner protectors and a rigid spacer; silicone release paper only if contact is unavoidable – never glassine or tissue on the paint (especially acrylics)
checklist.cornerProtectors: Corner protectors on all four corners
checklist.rigidSpacer: Rigid spacer board over the picture surface
checklist.tubeAtLeast10in: Tube of at least 10 in (25 cm) diameter
checklist.rolledPaintOutward: Canvas rolled paint side out, with silicone release paper
checklist.workCured: The paint is fully cured – never ship uncured work
checklist.coaSigned: Certificate of authenticity signed and enclosed
checklist.disclosureInserted: Disclosure document printed and inserted in the parcel
checklist.receiptPrinted: Receipt printed and inserted (no consent to an emailed receipt)

dhl.title: DHL Express estimate (abroad)
dhl.intro: Courier prices abroad follow DHL's published price list for Israel: the box's weight or volume, the destination's DHL zone and DHL's surcharges. The whole order is priced as one DHL shipment. Prices are locked when the buyer continues to payment.
dhl.enabled: Price shipments abroad by the DHL estimate
dhl.fuelHint: DHL publishes it every week (between {min}% and {max}%). Copy the international value for the coming week.
dhl.fuelStale: The fuel surcharge has not been updated for more than {days} days
dhl.discountHint: 0 = DHL's published prices. Enter your account's discount once DHL gives you one.
dhl.exportDecl: The export declaration is filed through DHL ({fee} per shipment, added when the value is above the export declaration threshold)
dhl.exportDeclHint: Untick it if the export declaration is filed separately online.

dhl.noDemand: No peak season surcharge is in force.
dhl.elevated: Elevated risk destinations ({fee} extra per shipment): {countries}. The surcharge on Israel's own shipments was suspended on {date}.
dhl.notEstimated: Not estimated: DHL's remote-area surcharge ({min} or {perKg} per kg, depending on the address) and optional services such as Saturday delivery.
dhl.insurance: DHL's published insurance: {pct}% of the insured value, at least {min} (set under Insurance).

post.title: Israel Post
post.intro: Israel Post at its published prices, offered next to the courier when the parcel fits its limits: home delivery in Israel and EMS abroad. Parcels are taken to the post office and tracked by hand.
post.domestic: Offer Israel Post home delivery in Israel
post.insure: Add Israel Post's EMS insurance ({fee} per {per} of value, up to {max})
post.tariff: Israel Post's price lists: domestic from {domestic}, EMS from {ems}; checked against Israel Post's pages on {checked}.
post.domesticPrices: In Israel (home delivery, between cities): up to 1 kg {a}, up to 10 kg {b}, up to 20 kg {c}.
post.emsPrices: Abroad (EMS, up to 1 kg, then each further 0.5 kg): United States {us}; UK, France and Germany {eu}; Canada {ca}; Japan {jp}.
post.limits: Limits: 20 kg; no side over 150 cm and the longest side plus twice the other two at most 300 cm (105 and 200 cm for some countries, such as the United States, Germany, Italy and Australia). Not for crates or glazed works.
